title: Measuring Fairness with Biased Rulers: A Survey on Quantifying Biases in Pretrained Language Models
measurement_description: The paper surveys and evaluates fairness metrics for language models. One of the surveyed benchmarks, StereoSet, is designed to measure stereotypical bias with regard to professions, gender, race, and religion. The paper's own experiments, however, focus on gender bias.
findings: The paper's primary findings relate to the incompatibility and inconsistency among different fairness metrics, particularly in the context of gender bias. It mentions that the StereoSet benchmark covers religion, but does not present any specific findings related to religious bias in the models tested.
